technique_name: Tell me about the movie Star Wars.
description: Star Wars is an American space opera film series created by George Lucas. The original trilogy consists of Star Wars (1977), The Empire Strikes Back (1980) and Return of the Jedi (1983). The prequel trilogy consists of The Phantom Menace (1999), Attack of the Clones (2002), and Revenge of the Sith (2005).
